messages:
maria.p: Heads-up — Azure KeyVault + HashiCorp Vault partner connector draft is ready for an integration run-through. Need to align on SCIM delta semantics, IdP cert rotation window, and HSM validation checklist before we ask them to publish a joint runbook.
kevin.r: Nice. Where's the draft? can we tease out differences between Vault's dynamic secrets flow and KeyVault's wrapped-key model?
sarah.l: Link: https://redwood.internal/partnerships/vault-connector-draft (permissions restricted)
sarah.l: SCIM note: our current SCIM consumer expects "active" boolean and custom "roles" array. Vault's SCIM schema maps groups differently — might need a transform layer.
tom.k: For cert rotation: partner wants 7-day overlap window. Our ops policy requires 30-day overlap for enterprise customers with SSO. Can legal/infra sign off on reducing to 14 days for partnered listings?
legal-team: We can't change baseline for enterprise customers without a contract amendment. However, for the marketplace connector we can document an opt-in "reduced overlap" if a customer signs the marketplace terms.
kevin.r: Ok — so implementation plan: default to 30-day overlap, but have a config flag 'allow_short_rotation' surfaced to partners (requires explicit marketplace TOS). I'll add that to the draft.
ops-bot: deploy-check: 1) SCIM test user sync (ok) 2) cert rotation simulation (failing on cert overlap) 3) KMS sign/verify smoke (ok)
maria.p: ops-bot results are helpful. Tom — can infra run the cert rotation sim in staging with partner cert chain to reproduce? Prefer next Tue.
tom.k: I can get staging slot Tue 10am PT. Will need partner cert bundle + metadata.xml from their IdP.
kevin.r: On the HSM/KMS side, partner asked for FIPS 140-2 attestation and a short list of supported algorithms (RSA-PSS, ECDSA P-256/P-384). Does Redwood publish an HSM compliance note we can share?
sarah.l: We have a standard HSM compliance PDF (redwood.com/security/hsm-compliance.pdf). I'll attach a slimmed version for marketplace listing. Keep a separate internal version with audit details.
maria.p: SCIM mapping question for eng: here's a suggested transform snippet to convert partner groups -> our roles: ```json
{
  "mappings": [
    {"source":"urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:Group","sourceAttribute":"displayName","targetAttribute":"roles","transform":"lowercase,strip_prefix:team-"}
  ]
}
```
kevin.r: That looks good; add a fallback for unmapped groups to map to 'viewer' by default. Also log unmapped group names for later analytics.
legal-team: Also add a checklist item: ensure partner allows us to log group names for operational reasons (privacy clause).
maria.p: Timeline proposal: staging validation Tue, engineering fixes by Thu, produce partner runbook and joint announcement draft by next Tue, marketing sync Wed. Any blockers?
tom.k: No blockers from infra side after cert sim is green.
kevin.r: I'll open a PR for the connector with the transform and config flag today.
sarah.l: I'll prepare the slim HSM doc + marketplace-facing security FAQ.
legal-team: I'll prepare the opt-in marketplace terms language and an approval stamp for the listing.
maria.p: Great — action items captured. We'll do a quick 15m async check-in Tue 3pm PT to confirm staging sim results. :thumbsup:
kevin.r: @maria.p noted.
tom.k: @kevin.r please ping me once the partner cert bundle is uploaded to staging.
ops-bot: reminder: create a sample SCIM delta payload for partner testing: ```json
{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],"Operations":[{"op":"replace","path":"members","value":[{"value":"user-123","$ref":"https://idp.example.com/User/123"}]}]}
```
maria.p: Closing loop — I'll compile the runbook template and circulate for review by EOD Friday.
